unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #10 on jayyu23/x402-zkid: Add a feeless, self-custody XNO settlement leg beside USDC (GH write path open). Framed in their terms: their issues #5/#7 "fix payment facilitator"/"update to cdp x402 facilitator" prove the rail is owned by a third party. Offered XNO as a second accepts[] asset - ~1s, zero fee, self-custody via merchants own key (docs.nano.org key-management, ~100 lines + one test vector), no account, matches their "server knows what you are, never who". Receipt = public block anyone can re-read. Tool: extract.paypercall.dev nano-info 0.0005 XNO + nanswap USDC-BASE/XNO.
